message: One of our (four) cats also regularly paddles in the bowl, with much the same decorative flair. This is also the cat who has long since gnawed the artificial pink fur from her little plastic mouse toy and carries it around in her mouth, caterwauling and inviting us to play by jumping on the bed at 3am. Throw into the mix The Barfer, The Gadfly, and Toilet Tim, and a big hairy dog; it's a zoo around here.
